title: The FCC warns TP-Link that three routers exceeded power limits and it may have submitted "false or incorrect information", a move that could allow further bans (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: The FCC warns TP-Link that three routers exceeded power limits and it may have submitted “false or incorrect information”, a move that could allow further bans — The Federal Communications Commission has told TP-Link Systems Inc. that some of its Wi-Fi routers are violating power level limits …
